title: Counting what was cut: a word-level measurement of the 2022-23 rationalisation of NCERT textbooks (code and data)
description: Code, count tables, figures and logs for a word-level comparison of 56 NCERT textbooks before and after the 2022-23 rationalisation, and a check of NCERT's official deletion lists against the books. Textbook text is not included.
